name: Single Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press with one foot on the platform and the other leg relaxed or off.
Lower the sled by bending your knee toward your chest.
Press through your whole foot to extend.
Re-lock the safeties and switch legs.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A machine leg press done with one leg at a time to train the quads and glutes while correcting side-to-side imbalances.

safetyNotes: Use a lighter weight than two-leg presses; use safeties.
